package mailnotify

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

// Port of the door-code mail builders in App/app/mail_notify.py: build_door_code,
// _fee_block, door_code_notice / _door_code_notice, door_code_delayed_notice,
// _door_code_payload and _door_code_reason. The copy comes from doorcode_i18n.go.
// testdata/door_code_golden.json is generated by App/scripts/go_mailnotify_doorcode_golden.py.

// doorCodeMarker is mail.DOOR_CODE_MARKER: the outbox swaps it for the PIN at send time.
const doorCodeMarker = "{{door_code}}"

// qrContentID is mail.QR_CONTENT_ID, the cid the QR image is referenced by.
const qrContentID = "stayfeeqr"

// doorHostMailLanguage is HOST_MAIL_LANGUAGE in mail_notify.py.
const doorHostMailLanguage = "en"

// DoorCodeFee is the fee dict build_door_code takes (_fee_block). An absent fee is a nil
// pointer, the Python None or empty dict.
type DoorCodeFee struct {
	Total int       `json:"total"`
	Rate  int       `json:"rate"`
	Lines []FeeLine `json:"lines"`
	VS    string    `json:"vs"`
	Ways  []FeeWay  `json:"ways"`
}

// FeeLine is one (days, amount) pair of the fee, JSON as a two-element array.
type FeeLine struct {
	Days   int
	Amount int
}

// UnmarshalJSON reads the [days, amount] pair the Python dict holds as a tuple.
func (l *FeeLine) UnmarshalJSON(b []byte) error {
	var pair [2]int
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &pair); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	l.Days, l.Amount = pair[0], pair[1]
	return nil
}

// FeeWay is one payment way: key is "iban", "revolut" or "cash". Empty strings are the
// missing keys (Python dict.get returns None, which is falsy here too).
type FeeWay struct {
	Key     string `json:"key"`
	Payee   string `json:"payee"`
	Account string `json:"account"`
	Spayd   string `json:"spayd"`
	Link    string `json:"link"`
	Note    string `json:"note"`
}

// DoorCodeInput is build_door_code's keyword arguments. Host is the optional host
// dict (nil when the Python call passes none).
type DoorCodeInput struct {
	Lang         string
	PropertyName string
	Checkin      string
	Checkout     string
	FirstUseBy   string
	Host         *Host
	Fee          *DoorCodeFee
}

// DoorCodeOutput is what build_door_code returns. QRSpayd is "" when there is no QR.
type DoorCodeOutput struct {
	Subject string
	Text    string
	HTML    string
	QRSpayd string
}

// BuildDoorCode is build_door_code. publicBaseURL is config.PUBLIC_BASE_URL without a
// trailing slash (the logo origin).
func BuildDoorCode(publicBaseURL string, in DoorCodeInput) DoorCodeOutput {
	lang := in.Lang
	subject := doorGuestText(lang, "mail_door_code_subject", Args{"property": in.PropertyName})
	title := doorGuestText(lang, "door_code_title", nil)
	times := doorGuestText(lang, "door_code_times", Args{"checkin": in.Checkin, "checkout": in.Checkout})
	footer := GuestFooterLines(lang, in.PropertyName, in.Host)
	codeLine := doorCodeMarker
	blocks := []string{
		BlockHeading(title),
		BlockParagraphSized(codeLine, false, 22),
		BlockParagraph(times, false),
	}
	textLines := []string{title, codeLine, "", times}
	if in.FirstUseBy != "" {
		firstUse := doorGuestText(lang, "door_code_first_use", Args{"deadline": in.FirstUseBy})
		blocks = append(blocks, BlockParagraph(firstUse, false))
		textLines = append(textLines, firstUse)
	}
	spayd := ""
	if in.Fee != nil {
		feeBlocks, feeText, s := doorFeeBlock(lang, in.Fee)
		blocks = append(blocks, feeBlocks...)
		textLines = append(textLines, "")
		textLines = append(textLines, feeText...)
		spayd = s
	}
	lines := append(textLines, "", "--")
	lines = append(lines, FooterText(footer)...)
	html := Shell(ShellParams{
		PublicBaseURL: publicBaseURL,
		Lang:          lang,
		Title:         in.PropertyName,
		Preheader:     title,
		Blocks:        blocks,
		FooterLines:   footer,
	})
	return DoorCodeOutput{Subject: subject, Text: strings.Join(lines, "\n"), HTML: html, QRSpayd: spayd}
}

// doorFeeBlock is _fee_block: the fee rows, the payment ways and the QR cid. It returns
// the blocks, the text lines and the SPAYD string ("" when there is no QR).
func doorFeeBlock(lang string, fee *DoorCodeFee) ([]string, []string, string) {
	var blocks, text []string
	spayd := ""
	feeHeading := doorGuestText(lang, "mail_completion_fee_heading", nil)
	feeTotal := doorGuestText(lang, "mail_completion_fee_total", Args{"total": fee.Total})
	blocks = append(blocks, BlockHeading(feeHeading), BlockParagraph(feeTotal, false))
	text = append(text, feeHeading, feeTotal)

	feeRows := make([]PanelRow, 0, len(fee.Lines))
	for i, line := range fee.Lines {
		feeRows = append(feeRows, PanelRow{
			Label: doorGuestText(lang, "fee_guest_n", Args{"n": i + 1}),
			Value: doorGuestText(lang, "fee_person_line", Args{"days": line.Days, "rate": fee.Rate, "amount": line.Amount}),
		})
	}
	calcTitle := doorGuestText(lang, "mail_completion_fee_calc_title", nil)
	blocks = append(blocks, BlockPanel(calcTitle, feeRows, nil, ""))
	text = append(text, "", calcTitle)
	for _, r := range feeRows {
		text = append(text, r.Label+": "+r.Value)
	}

	amountText := doorGuestText(lang, "fee_amount", Args{"amount": fee.Total})
	if len(fee.Ways) == 0 {
		noRails := doorGuestText(lang, "fee_no_rails", nil)
		blocks = append(blocks, BlockParagraph(noRails, false))
		text = append(text, "", noRails)
	} else {
		once := doorGuestText(lang, "mail_completion_fee_once", nil)
		blocks = append(blocks, BlockParagraph(once, false))
		text = append(text, "", once)
	}
	for _, way := range fee.Ways {
		switch way.Key {
		case "iban":
			title := doorGuestText(lang, "fee_rail_iban", nil)
			var rows []PanelRow
			if way.Payee != "" {
				rows = append(rows, PanelRow{Label: doorGuestText(lang, "fee_payee", nil), Value: way.Payee})
			}
			rows = append(rows,
				PanelRow{Label: doorGuestText(lang, "fee_iban", nil), Value: way.Account, Mono: true},
				PanelRow{Label: doorGuestText(lang, "fee_amount_label", nil), Value: amountText},
				PanelRow{Label: doorGuestText(lang, "fee_vs_label", nil), Value: fee.VS, Mono: true},
			)
			blocks = append(blocks, BlockPanel(title, rows, nil, ""))
			text = append(text, "", title)
			for _, r := range rows {
				text = append(text, r.Label+": "+r.Value)
			}
			if way.Spayd != "" {
				qrAlt := doorGuestText(lang, "fee_qr_alt", nil)
				blocks = append(blocks,
					`<tr><td style="padding:8px 24px 0 24px;">`+
						`<img src="cid:`+qrContentID+`" width="200" height="200" alt="`+Esc(qrAlt)+
						`" style="display:block;border:0;width:200px;height:200px;"></td></tr>`)
				spayd = way.Spayd
			}
		case "revolut":
			label := doorGuestText(lang, "fee_revolut_button", Args{"amount": amountText})
			blocks = append(blocks, BlockButton(way.Link, label))
			text = append(text, "", label+": "+way.Link)
		case "cash":
			note := way.Note
			if note == "" {
				note = doorGuestText(lang, "fee_cash_default", nil)
			}
			line := doorGuestText(lang, "fee_rail_cash", nil) + ": " + note
			blocks = append(blocks, BlockParagraph(line, false))
			text = append(text, "", line)
		}
	}
	already := doorGuestText(lang, "mail_completion_fee_already", nil)
	blocks = append(blocks, BlockParagraph(already, false))
	text = append(text, "", already)
	return blocks, text, spayd
}

// DoorCodeMailEnv is the configuration the notice builders read: config.app_base_url()
// (APP_BASE_URL or PUBLIC_BASE_URL), config.PUBLIC_BASE_URL for the logo, and
// config.SUPPORT_EMAIL.
type DoorCodeMailEnv struct {
	AppBaseURL    string
	PublicBaseURL string
	SupportEmail  string
}

// DoorCodeNoticeIn is the input of _door_code_notice, after the database reads: the
// apartment's internal name and the reservation's date_from, the door_code row's
// last_error, and the PIN (Pin is used only when HasPin, which is pin_enc being set).
type DoorCodeNoticeIn struct {
	DoorCodeID    int64
	ReservationID int64
	Variant       string
	KeySuffix     string
	PropertyName  string
	DateFrom      string
	LastError     string
	HasPin        bool
	Pin           string
}

// DoorCodeDelayedIn is the input of door_code_delayed_notice after its reads.
type DoorCodeDelayedIn struct {
	ReservationID int64
	PropertyName  string
	DateFrom      string
	Reason        string
}

// DoorCodeNoticeOut is the mail.enqueue call a notice makes, minus the ids the caller
// already holds. ToEmail is left to the caller (legal_entity.contact_email).
type DoorCodeNoticeOut struct {
	Kind           string // "door_code_notice"
	IdempotencyKey string
	Subject        string
	Text           string
	HTML           string
	Lang           string
	CC             string // "" when there is no cc
}

// doorSupportCopyVariants is _SUPPORT_COPY_VARIANTS: these notices copy support.
var doorSupportCopyVariants = map[string]bool{
	"failed":            true,
	"delayed":           true,
	"period_taken":      true,
	"period_shared":     true,
	"moved_not_deleted": true,
	"moved_failed":      true,
	"pin_unverified":    true,
}

// doorNoRetry is _DOOR_CODE_NO_RETRY: reasons where nothing is retried.
var doorNoRetry = map[string]bool{"not_set_up": true, "not_eligible": true, "bad_window": true}

// doorReasons is _DOOR_CODE_REASONS.
var doorReasons = map[string]bool{
	"waiting": true, "not_set_up": true, "no_account": true, "not_eligible": true,
	"bad_window": true, "cloud": true, "offline": true, "permission": true,
	"storage": true, "budget": true, "lock_setup": true, "support": true,
}

// doorReasonKinds is _DOOR_CODE_REASON_KINDS: TTLock error kinds as the reason a host reads.
var doorReasonKinds = map[string]string{
	"transient":    "cloud",
	"network":      "cloud",
	"rate":         "cloud",
	"auth":         "cloud",
	"offline":      "offline",
	"permission":   "permission",
	"reauth":       "no_account",
	"storage":      "storage",
	"budget":       "budget",
	"config":       "support",
	"bug":          "other",
	"code_missing": "other",
}

// DoorCodeReason is _door_code_reason: the reason as a sentence a host can act on, with
// the raw token in brackets for support.
func DoorCodeReason(env DoorCodeMailEnv, lang, reason string) string {
	parts := strings.Split(reason, ":")
	kind := parts[0]
	if parts[0] == "period_taken" && len(parts) > 1 {
		kind = parts[1]
	}
	key, ok := doorReasonKinds[kind]
	if !ok {
		key = kind
	}
	if !doorReasons[key] {
		key = "other"
	}
	text := doorHostText(lang, "mail.door_code_reason."+key, Args{"support": env.SupportEmail})
	return text + " [" + reason + "]"
}

// BuildDoorCodeNotice is _door_code_notice from the point the rows are read: the
// variant's subject and body, the stay button and the payload, the cc and the
// idempotency key. The caller skips the mail when the entity has no contact address.
func BuildDoorCodeNotice(env DoorCodeMailEnv, in DoorCodeNoticeIn) DoorCodeNoticeOut {
	lang := HostLanguage(doorHostMailLanguage)
	params := Args{"property": in.PropertyName, "date": stayDay(in.DateFrom)}
	if in.Variant == "failed" || in.Variant == "moved_failed" {
		reason := strings.TrimSpace(in.LastError)
		if reason == "" {
			reason = "other"
		}
		params["reason"] = DoorCodeReason(env, lang, reason)
	}
	if in.Variant == "cancelled_not_deleted" && in.HasPin {
		params["code"] = "••••" + lastRunes(in.Pin, 2)
	}
	key := fmt.Sprintf("door_code_notice:%d:%s", in.DoorCodeID, in.Variant)
	if in.KeySuffix != "" {
		key += ":" + in.KeySuffix
	}
	out := doorNoticeMail(env, lang, in.Variant, params, in.ReservationID)
	out.IdempotencyKey = key
	if doorSupportCopyVariants[in.Variant] {
		out.CC = env.SupportEmail
	}
	return out
}

// BuildDoorCodeDelayedNotice is door_code_delayed_notice from the point the rows are read.
// One mail per stay, key door_code_notice:stay<id>:delayed, support always in copy.
func BuildDoorCodeDelayedNotice(env DoorCodeMailEnv, in DoorCodeDelayedIn) DoorCodeNoticeOut {
	lang := HostLanguage(doorHostMailLanguage)
	reason := in.Reason
	if reason == "" {
		reason = "waiting"
	}
	params := Args{
		"property": in.PropertyName,
		"date":     stayDay(in.DateFrom),
		"reason":   DoorCodeReason(env, lang, reason),
	}
	variant := "delayed"
	if doorNoRetry[reason] {
		variant = "failed"
	}
	out := doorNoticeMail(env, lang, variant, params, in.ReservationID)
	out.IdempotencyKey = fmt.Sprintf("door_code_notice:stay%d:delayed", in.ReservationID)
	out.CC = env.SupportEmail
	return out
}

// doorNoticeMail is the shared tail of the two notices: _door_code_payload's text and
// branded HTML, and the subject from the variant's copy.
func doorNoticeMail(env DoorCodeMailEnv, lang, variant string, params Args, reservationID int64) DoorCodeNoticeOut {
	subject := doorHostText(lang, "mail.door_code_notice."+variant+".subject", params)
	body := doorHostText(lang, "mail.door_code_notice."+variant+".body", params)
	stayURL := env.AppBaseURL + fmt.Sprintf("/reservations/%d#now", reservationID)
	action := doorHostText(lang, "mail.door_code_notice.action", nil)
	blocks := []string{
		BlockParagraph(body, false),
		BlockButton(stayURL, action),
		BlockLink(stayURL, doorGuestText(lang, "mail_link_fallback", nil)),
	}
	return DoorCodeNoticeOut{
		Kind:    "door_code_notice",
		Subject: subject,
		Text:    body + "\n\n" + action + ": " + stayURL,
		HTML: Shell(ShellParams{
			PublicBaseURL: env.PublicBaseURL,
			Lang:          lang,
			Title:         subject,
			Preheader:     subject,
			Blocks:        blocks,
			FooterLines:   []any{"UbyHost"},
		}),
		Lang: lang,
	}
}

// stayDay is the stay's date as dd.mm.yyyy (datetime.fromisoformat(...).strftime), or the
// raw value when it does not parse, as the Python except branch does. It accepts the
// date and the date-time forms fromisoformat takes for these columns.
func stayDay(raw string) string {
	layouts := []string{
		"2006-01-02",
		"2006-01-02T15:04:05",
		"2006-01-02 15:04:05",
		"2006-01-02T15:04",
		"2006-01-02 15:04",
	}
	for _, layout := range layouts {
		if t, err := time.Parse(layout, raw); err == nil {
			return t.Format("02.01.2006")
		}
	}
	return raw
}

// lastRunes is pin[-n:] with Python's character indexing; the whole value when shorter.
func lastRunes(s string, n int) string {
	if utf8.RuneCountInString(s) <= n {
		return s
	}
	r := []rune(s)
	return string(r[len(r)-n:])
}
